post.description: Generate minimal approved projections, sign outbound webhooks or issue expiring export access, deduplicate event delivery and log destination/version/status without secrets. Failure/recovery: Revoked recipient authority blocks new delivery and pending export download; arbitrary endpoint changes require renewed security review.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Actor/context/operation plus canonical body hash; same key/body returns stored outcome, changed body is 409.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Quoted decimal resourceVersion; expectedVersion body alias, when present, must be equal. Existing-resource edits require this precondition.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Required with SessionCookie plus Origin verification; absent only for explicitly scoped bearer/service or verified callback transport.

post.x-authorization: Routing destinations and recipient projections are approved contract artifacts; exports/webhooks obey the same tenant/field/purpose boundaries as interactive APIs.
post.x-state-authority: Feature-local workflow stage only; canonical persistence state machines own order/payment/issuance/ledger transitions.
post.x-contract-validation: Transport schema plus versioned domain/product/provider validation; not integration certification.

202.description: Durable local command receipt; queued is not issued/paid/externally accepted.

403.description: Permission, relationship, entitlement or feature denied

409.description: Stale revision, idempotency conflict, changed offer or race

Retry-After.description: Seconds before next attempt; does not authorize unknown external replay.
